title: Result
description: One immutable output of a node (docs/design/m0/13 "Model" [G1]). A result is never overwritten. Which result a computation key has selected, and the attempt that produced it (att_), are carried by the graph's result events (G3), not here. Freshness is read from the evidence receipt referenced in value (its valid_until, 06), not from a field of the result (13 [G2]; G4a). The controller computes the outcome from observed facts (13 "Facts, not claims"; the build table is G2's), never from an executor's claim. Only a completed result with outcome found, empty or failed is reusable (13 [G2]); internal/graph checks that a reason fits its outcome (02).

id.description: The identity of this output, minted by the controller for each output. It is never derived from the computation key.

value.description: The output's content, by exact reference (10). Manifests list result ids, never keys (13).

conclusions.description: The typed projection used only for reuse decisions (13), one schema per result kind. Only gate and evidence results carry one, since conclusions-only equivalence exists only on the review←gate and review←evidence edges (13 "v1 scope"); every other kind has null. A conclusive gate or evidence result (completed, and found, empty or failed) always has one.

detail.description: Non-empty for every outcome but empty (02 "Outcome").

completed.description: Whether execution observably completed: the executor reached a terminal result the controller accepted (05) and reported it found or empty. A reported could_not_run or failed is not completion, nor is a refused or missing result or a lost attempt. An incomplete result is could_not_run, never empty (13 "Facts, not claims").
